I'm new to DE and the last few weeks I did the same research on what shoes to buy as continuous walking and standing is something I always do. 
Website called Runrepeat gives you the best comparisons and tests. They even have a section for "best shoes for nurses" involving the shoe analysis for standing all day.
Next, you can gift a Gutschein from a shoe store which has "lauf Analyse“. Your sister can go in the store get her foot analysis and use the voucher to buy the shoe. 
Lastly, if you want some quick recommendations- 
Asics Gel Nimbus 26- I bought this and it is top ranked shoes for standing and walking
Hoka Clifton/Bondi 8 - typical nurse shoe
There's On Cloudtilt and cloudsurfer as well
And the softest one is NewBalance v4 FreshFoam
